description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output at a threshold of 1e-3 across 23 transformer layers, comparing three conditions: before gating, after gating, and after average gating. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to 23 using a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Sparsity Ratio,” ranges from 0.0 to 0.8 on a linear scale, with tick labels every 0.2. The blue dashed line, representing the sparsity ratio before the gate, remains nearly flat near 0.0 across all layers, with an average of 0.003. The green dash-dot line, corresponding to the sparsity ratio after the average gate, starts at approximately 0.8 at layer 0, drops sharply to about 0.05 by layer 5, and continues to decline gradually, stabilizing near 0.0 from layer 10 onward, with an overall average of 0.080. The orange dotted line, indicating the sparsity ratio after the gate, also begins near 0.8 at layer 0, decreases more slowly than the green line, reaching approximately 0.2 by layer 10, and exhibits minor fluctuations including a small peak near layer 21, with an average value of 0.126. Across the entire layer range, the green line (after average gate) consistently lies above the orange line (after gate), indicating higher sparsity under the average gating condition.
caption_used: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output at a threshold of 1e-3 across various layers. The x-axis is labeled 'Layer,' and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled 'Sparsity Ratio,' and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The blue dashed line, representing the sparsity ratio before the gate, starts at a ratio of approximately 0.0 at layer 0 and remains constant throughout. The green dash-dot line, representing the sparsity ratio after the average gate, begins at about 0.8 at layer 0 and decreases exponentially, reaching 0.05 at layer 5 and stabilizing near 0.0 from layer 10 onward. The orange dotted line, representing the sparsity ratio after the gate, shows a similar pattern to the green line, beginning at about 0.8 at layer 0 and decreasing to around 0.2 by layer 10, with a small spike after layer 20. Notably, the sparsity ratio after the average gate consistently exceeds the sparsity ratio after the gate across all layers.
